servers.name: PostgreSQL
servers.description: Connect to PostgreSQL databases and inspect or query database contents.
servers.requirements: Provide a PostgreSQL connection URL reachable from the isolated MCPlama runner. Use a least-privilege database account.

servers.name: Filesystem
servers.description: Read and manage files in the MCP runner container.
servers.requirements: The server sees paths inside its isolated MCPlama runner container. Host folders are not mounted. The default path is /tmp.

servers.name: Brave Search
servers.description: Search the web and retrieve related search results through Brave Search.
servers.requirements: Requires a Brave Search API key configured by the administrator.

servers.name: Playwright
servers.description: Playwright MCP server
servers.requirements: No external credentials identified; tool-specific arguments or local runtime configuration may still be required.

servers.name: Slack
servers.description: Connect to Slack workspaces to search and work with conversations and files.
servers.requirements: Create an approved Slack app and configure its OAuth client ID and secret for MCPlama. The OAuth app credentials are shared by this MCPlama deployment; each user signs in to their own Slack account.

servers.name: Jira (Atlassian)
servers.description: Connect to Jira and other Atlassian Cloud products through the official Atlassian MCP server.
servers.requirements: Endpoint: https://mcp.atlassian.com/v2/mcp. OAuth 2.1 sign-in or an administrator-configured Atlassian API token; an Atlassian Cloud site and product access are required. OAuth is completed by each user; no administrator-provided OAuth client secret is listed as required.

servers.name: Notion
servers.description: Search, read, and edit Notion workspace content using Notion’s hosted MCP server.
servers.requirements: Endpoint: https://mcp.notion.com/mcp. Users authenticate with Notion OAuth and the external MCP client must be allowed by the workspace.

servers.name: Figma
servers.description: Read design context and work with Figma files through Figma’s hosted MCP server.
servers.requirements: Endpoint: https://mcp.figma.com/mcp. Sign in with a Figma account with access to the selected file. Availability and write features depend on the Figma plan and supported client.

servers.name: Resend
servers.description: Send and manage email through Resend’s hosted MCP server.
servers.requirements: Endpoint: https://mcp.resend.com/mcp. Authenticate with Resend OAuth; a Resend API key is also supported for headless connections.

servers.name: RevenueCat
servers.description: Inspect and manage RevenueCat projects, products, customers, and subscriptions.
servers.requirements: Endpoint: https://mcp.revenuecat.ai/mcp. Authenticate with RevenueCat OAuth or provide an API v2 secret key.
